lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition MgCr₂ (Mg₈Cr₁₆ per cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 24 atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr-centered octahedra with six geometric neighbors (four Cr and two Mg, 2.35–2.60 Å) and Mg-centered six-vertex coordination polyhedra, alongside edge-sharing between Cr octahedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Cr polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
